facts.fact: 清晨翻车：她终于说出「我爱你」，他的退却瞬间写满全身——不动的身体与熄掉的眼睛。
facts.anchor: And she sensed his immediate withdrawal.

facts.fact: 逃跑说辞：他把她的告白归档为「事后温情错觉」——边说边以生平最快速度穿衣。
facts.anchor: ‘You do not love me, all right? You just think you love me because last night we had sex and women think soppy thoughts after sex.’

facts.fact: 底牌尽出：她说破孩子身世——那一晚是为了忘掉他；他听得脸色煞白。
facts.anchor: ‘Lizzie’s father was my one attempt to get you out of my system,’ she said quietly, watching as his face drained of colour.

facts.fact: 她的反证：二十二年随叫随到、Lizzie 出生后处处在场——这就是承诺，只是他不敢命名。
facts.anchor: ‘You have been there for me for every second of the last twenty-two years, Jack, and since Lizzie was born you’ve been there for her, too. If that isn’t commitment, then I don’t know what is.

facts.fact: 反向求婚：她把选择权推给他——求婚、过一生、Lizzie 得到梦想的爸爸。
facts.anchor: ‘I’m waiting for you to propose to me, Jack.

facts.fact: 决裂句：他抓起外套扔下「只是性」三个字摔门而去。
facts.anchor: For me it was just sex, Blondie—great sex, but just sex.

facts.fact: 圣诞前夜坦白：她终于告诉 Lizzie 圣诞老人送不来爸爸——女儿却笑着「just wait and see」。
facts.anchor: ‘And a daddy isn’t really something that Santa can bring you.’

facts.fact: 平安夜：袜子、肉馅饼、威士忌、驯鹿胡萝卜——Lizzie 自信满满入睡，反讽拉满。
